title_as_printed: Experimental Water Content and Dew-Point Temperatures and Pressures for {Methane + Carbon Dioxide + rho_water} Systems
footnotes_as_printed: not captured (none printed); mixture compositions in Table 1 of the paper: mixture 1 CO2 20 / CH4 80, mixture 2 CO2 70 / CH4 30, mixture 3 CO2 45 / C2H6 55, mixture 4 CO2 95 / C2H6 5 mol %, each +/- 1
pressure_note: dew-point pressure recorded at the chilled-mirror inlet (PI6), set by a regulator valve; paper does not say absolute or gauge; 'pressure, P (10^5 Pa)'

T.what: dew-point temperature of the gas of the given water content at pressure P

value.what: water content rho_water, in kg m-3(n), printed only in each block label as 'x 10^-6 kg m-3(n)'; set via group_rows value.constant; measured by Karl Fischer titration at the condenser outlet at atmospheric pressure

volume_basis_evidence: printed unit 'kg m-3(n)'; the paper does not define '(n)' (normal conditions) nor whether the volume is of dry gas or humid gas

composition.other_species: gas phase: dry CH4/CO2 (Table 2) or C2H6/CO2 (Table 3) gravimetric mixtures with water; gas composition per block in group_rows path gas_composition

skip_rows.reason: block label rows (mixture and water content)

conversion_needs: water content in kg m-3(n) needs the normal-condition definition (T, p) and dry/humid basis to become a mole fraction
dew points are one T-P curve per water content; builder must treat T,P as the dew-point conditions for that fixed water content
notes: Each block is printed as two side-by-side column pairs; stacked left pair first, then right pair (T and P increase continuously across the stack). Rows with T below 273.15 K (rows listed in paper.json) are dew points below the ice point (below_273K; water dew/frost point; paper does not say liquid or solid).
